revision_summary: Four timestamp errors flagged by the deterministic check must be corrected in script_coverage: (1) the $300/month bill quote belongs at 01:12, not 00:49; (2) the customer's 'Yeah. Sure. Alright.' agreement to the three-way call belongs at 02:08, not 01:36; (3) the rep's 11am/noon offer belongs at 10:33-10:37, not 09:35; (4) the customer's 'I'll make it noon then' belongs at 10:47, not 09:35. These are wrong_ts errors (words exist, timestamps are off) — all minor severity but all four should be fixed in one pass since they cluster in the same section (script_coverage) and affect the accuracy of the call-shape timeline a manager would review. Additionally: (a) tighten schema_reference citations in cherry_pick_moments[2] and [3] — elderly_low_tech_protocol and landline_protocol are being applied to a scenario (no bill/no login, resolved via live three-way utility call) that doesn't match either trigger condition; relabel as a novel/undocumented bill-collection workaround rather than mapping to specific schema sub-protocols that don't fit. (b) Add a cherry_pick_moments entry or expand the interest_reason_audit to note that the required verify.interest_in_solar item was never asked at all — this is a verify-completion gap, not just an unused flip opportunity, and should be visible to a manager reviewing schema adherence. (c) Optionally split the appointment_set script_coverage entry into day-selection (09:41) and time-selection (10:33-10:49) sub-moments for timeline clarity, though this is a nice-to-have not a blocker.
